items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: But when he did get his hands on enough money together to record it, he gave us this date that Bird cracked up on.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in Tempo Music. That was his thing. He couldn't just say, 'Well, okay, I'll record the band.' But when he did get his hands on enough money together to record it, he gave us this date that Bird cracked up on. So when Bird cracked up, that really blew... Because he thought he had lost his ass! He finally got all this money together, and now this cat can't play. So he was very much disturbed by it. And I don't blame him; I guess I would have been too. But I tried to pull it out for him, because I knew…
